Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

videos.caption: LASAGNA SOUP ingredients:  1 lb ground beef  1/2 yellow onion, diced  4 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp butter  1/2 box of lasagna noodles, broken 2 spoonfuls of tomato paste 1 jar of marinara sauce, 28 oz  1 box of beef broth, 32 oz 1/2 C heavy cream  1/4 c fresh parsley  Parmesan cheese, small handful  Mozzarella cheese, small handful  Fresh Basil  Salt Pepper Tony’s creole seasoning  Red pepper flakes Paprika  Italian seasoning  Oregano Black pepper  Adobo seasoning  Cream mixture:  Ricotta Parmesan  Mozzarella  Parsley  Directions:  1. In a big pot, on medium- low heat, add in your butter. Sauté your onion until translucent & toss in your garlic. Once garlic is fragrant, add in your ground beef.  2. Season your ground beef & cook until browned. Add in your 2 tbsp of tomato paste. Mix with your beef with tomato paste & cook for 3-4 mins before adding in your marinara sauce.  3. Once marinara comes to a simmer, add in your beef broth. Bring heat to med-high. Once your meat sauce comes to boil add in your lasagna pieces. Cover & let it cook for 6-7 mins 4. Toss in your heavy cream, with Parmesan & mozzarella cheese. Follow that with a second round of the same seasonings (a little less than before). Mix before adding in your fresh parsley & fresh basil. Cover for another 5 mins, let it simmer on low.  5. For ricotta mixture: in a small bowl add 2 parts ricotta, 1 part mozzarella & Parmesan. Add in fresh basil. Mix.  6. Serve your lasagna soup with ricotta mixture, garnish with parsley & Parmesan  7. Enjoy :)  #lasagnasoup #fallrecipes #soupseason #soup #easyrecipe

If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles These Mongolian Ground Beef Noodles are an easy, flavorful dinner. This is a quick dinner the whole family will love! Thank you for the inspo @britscookin 🫶 Ingredients 1 lb ground beef 4 packages ramen noodles, seasoning packets discarded (about 10–12 oz) Salt and black pepper, to taste 8 oz mushrooms, sliced 1 head broccoli, cut into florets 1/3 cup water, for steaming broccoli Mongolian Sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/3 cup brown sugar 2 tbsp hoisin sauce 1 tbsp minced garlic 1 tsp fresh ginger paste  1 tsp sesame oil 1/2 tsp red pepper flakes, optional Cornstarch Slurry 1 tbsp cornstarch 2 tbsp cold water Directions 1. Add the ground beef to a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Season with salt and black pepper to taste. Drain any excess grease if needed. 2. Add the mushrooms and broccoli into the skillet.  3. Add 1/3 of water to the skillet and cover to let the broccoli steam for a few minutes.  4. While the broccoli is steaming, cook the ramen noodles according to the package directions, leaving out the seasoning packets. Drain and set aside. 5. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, chicken broth, brown sugar, hoisin sauce, garlic, ginger, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. 6. Pour the Mongolian sauce over the beef, mushrooms, and broccoli. Stir until everything is well combined. 7. Whisk together the cornstarch and cold water. Pour the slurry into the skillet and let everything simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens. 8. Add the cooked ramen noodles and toss until everything is coated in the sauce. #EasyRecipe #DinnerIdeas #quickrecipes #onepotmeals #easydinner

One of my favorite soups, perfect for fall 🍂Loaded with Italian sausage, tender lasagna noodles, and all the cheesy goodness. The ultimate cozy comfort meal! Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio! 🤎 Lasagna soup Ingredients: 	⁃	1 small onion, diced 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Parsley 	⁃	Basil 	⁃	1 lb mild Italian sausage 	⁃	2 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	5 cups chicken stock 	⁃	24 oz marinara sauce 	⁃	1/4 tsp thyme 	⁃	1/2 tsp chili flakes 	⁃	1 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	1/2 tsp paprika  	⁃	1 tsp Italian seasoning 	⁃	1/2 tsp oregano 	⁃	1 tbsp tomato bullion 	⁃	Parmesan rind 	⁃	6-8 sheets lasagne noodles 	⁃	1/2 cup Parmesan 	⁃	1/3 cup mozzarella 	⁃	1/3 cup heavy cream Ricotta mixture 	⁃	1/3 cup ricotta 	⁃	1/4 cup mozzarella 	⁃	1 tbsp basil 	⁃	2 tbsp parsley 	⁃	1 tsp onion powder 	⁃	1 tsp garlic powder  	⁃	Salt and pepper to taste Instructions: Dice the onion and mince the garlic. Heat about 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add the onion and garlic and sauté until the onion is translucent. Add the Italian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks. Stir in the tomato paste, chicken stock, marinara sauce, spices, and fresh basil. Mix well. Break the lasagna sheets into smaller pieces and add them to the pot, along with the Parmesan rind. Cover and simmer on low heat for 20–25 minutes, or until the lasagna noodles are tender. Remove the Parmesan rind, then stir in the Parmesan, mozzarella, and heavy cream. Simmer for another 5 minutes. Serve warm, topped with the ricotta mixture and fresh parsley. Enjoy! #lasaganasoup #soupseason #souprecipe #fall #fallrecipes

High Protein Cheesy Honey Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas🔥🍯🍗 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 10 Total) 484 Calories 33C | 14gF | 65gP Ingredients: 1.8KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1.5 Packets Chipotle Seasoning (homemade or Cholula Chipotle Seasoning) 1 Tsp Olive Oil 400g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 2 Tsp Chipotle Seasoning (Cholula) 80ml Light Mayonnaise (Heinz) 2 Garlic Cloves 1/2 Juiced Lime 2 Tsp Chipotle In Adobo Sauce (La Costena) 80ml Buffalo Sauce (Franks Redhot Buffalo Sauce) 100g Honey 40g Light Grated Cheese Diced Chives 10 Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Grated Cheddar Cheese (Bega 50% Less Fat Grated Cheese - per quesadilla) Directions: 1. Start by seasoning your chicken breast with chipotle seasoning, olive oil & mix. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken with a lid for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side or until fully cooked through, once cooked shred the chicken apart using 2 forks. 3. In a blender cup add low fat cottage cheese, chipotle seasoning, light mayonnaise, garlic, lime juice, chipotle in adobo sauce, buffalo sauce, honey & blend for 2 minutes until smooth & creamy. 4. In a large bowl combined the blended chipotle sauce, shredded chicken, chives & grated cheese until well combined. 5. Place a warm tortilla down & to one half add a layer of cheese followed by 1/10th of the filling, another layer of cheese & fold. 6. Toast on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas.  #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

Day 24 of sharing easy dinner recipes! 🍽️  Kielbasa Broccoli Alfredo Pasta  INGREDIENTS 16 oz box Cellentani pasta 12 oz broccoli florets, chopped small 14 oz package kielbasa, sliced  1 1/2 cups mozzarella cheese 1 1/2 cups Colby Jack cheese  15 oz jar Alfredo sauce  1 ranch seasoning packet  Dried parsley  INSTRUCTIONS  Boil the pasta following the directions on the box. Add the cooked pasta to a greased 9x13 baking dish.  Add the chopped broccoli (make sure it’s in small pieces), sliced kielbasa, shredded mozzarella cheese, shredded Colby Jack cheese, 1 jar of Alfredo sauce, and a ranch seasoning packet.  Stir everything together well. Top with more cheese.  Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 400 degrees F for 30 minutes. Take off the foil and let cook for a couple more minutes or place it under the broil if you want it more browned.  Top with dried parsley and serve! If the Alfredo sauce settles to the bottom of the pan, stir before serving.  #easyrecipes #easydinners #pastabake

Recipe Name Creamy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Breast Ingredients 1. 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2. 2 tbsp olive oil 3. 2 tbsp butter 4. 4 garlic cloves, minced 5. 1 tsp Italian seasoning 6. 1 tsp paprika 7. 1 tsp salt 8. 1/2 tsp black pepper 9. 1 cup heavy cream 10. 1/2 cup chicken broth 11. 3/4 cup grated Parmesan cheese 12. 1 tsp garlic powder 13. 1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Recipe 1. Season the chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and Italian seasoning. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Sear the chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. 4. Remove the chicken and keep warm. 5. Melt the butter in the same pan. 6. Add the minced garlic and cook until fragrant. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and heavy cream, stirring well. 8. Add Parmesan cheese and cook until the sauce becomes smooth and creamy. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. 10. Simmer for 3–5 minutes so the flavors combine. 11. Garnish with fresh parsley. 12. Serve with mashed potatoes, pasta, or roasted vegetables. Follow for more delicious recipes!

Creamy Lasagna Soup for 2.  Easy one pot comfort food.  Happy first of September ☺️ Ingredients (Adjust all seasonings to your taste) 200-250g beef mince ½ red bell pepper, diced 1 small onion, diced 3 cloves garlic, minced 1-2 tbsp tomato purée 400 ml passata 2 cups (480 ml) vegetable stock (or whatever you have) ½ cup (120 ml) double cream 4-5 lasagna sheets, broken into pieces ½ tsp dried oregano ½ tsp Italian seasoning 1 tbsp fresh basil, chopped  2 tbsp chopped parsley  1 tbsp butter or olive oil 1 tsp sugar Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic and onion powder  1 tsp paprika  1 tsp chili flakes  60–80 g mozzarella grated  Parmesan, to taste 2 tbsp ricotta or cream cheese mixed with Parmesan cheese and parsley (for topping) Method Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onion and red bell pepper and sauté for 4–5 minutes until softened. Add the minced beef and cook for 4–5 minutes, breaking it up as it browns. Add the garlic and tomato paste and cook for about 1 minute. Add all seasonings then stir well  Pour in the passata and add sugar. Pour the vegetable stock. Stir and bring to a gentle simmer. Break the lasagna sheets into bite-sized pieces and add them to the soup. Simmer for 8–12 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is tender. Lower the heat and stir in the double cream. Warm gently for 2–3 minutes without bringing it to a vigorous boil. Taste and adjust the seasoning. Stir in fresh basil and parsley. Add mozzarella and Parmesan, allowing the mozzarella to melt into the soup. #lasagnasoup #soupseason #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #comfortfood

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Crockpot French Onion Dip Sandwiches Tender, fall-apart chuck roast slow cooked with buttery onions and savory au jus, then piled onto toasted buns with melty provolone. And of course, you have to serve them with that rich au jus for dipping! Servings: 6–8  Ingredients For the Roast 2 lb chuck roast Garlic powder, to taste Onion powder, to taste Black pepper, to taste Buttery garlic & herb seasoning, to taste @Kinder's Flavors  4 tbsp butter 1 packet au jus gravy mix @Fire & Smoke Society  1 packet beefy onion soup mix 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 2 cups chicken broth For the Onions 1 large yellow onion, thinly sliced 2 tbsp butter For Serving Hoagie or sub rolls Provolone cheese Instructions 1. Evenly season the chuck roast on all sides with garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and buttery garlic & herb seasoning. 2. Melt 4 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chuck roast and sear for 2–3 minutes per side, or until nicely browned. Transfer the roast to your slow cooker. 3. Sprinkle the au jus gravy mix and beefy onion soup mix over the roast. Add the Worcestershire sauce and chicken broth. 4. In the same skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter. Add the sliced onion and cook over medium heat for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened and lightly caramelized. 5. Spoon the onions directly over the roast. Cover and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours, or until the beef is fall-apart tender. 6. Remove the roast from the slow cooker and shred it with two forks. Return the beef to the slow cooker and toss it with some of the onions and juices. 7. Pile the shredded beef and onions onto your buns and top with provolone cheese. For extra melty cheese, pop the assembled sandwiches under the broiler for a minute or two. 8. Ladle some of the cooking liquid from the slow cooker into small bowls and serve alongside the sandwiches for dipping. #EasyRecipe #crockpot #slowcooker #DinnerIdeas #comfortfood

Creamy Herb Chicken & Spaghetti Noodle Soup Ingredients 2 large carrots, diced 2 celery stalks, diced ½ large yellow onion, diced 2 chicken breasts, diced 1½ teaspoons each: Garlic powder, Thyme, Parsley, Oregano, Buttery garlic & herb seasoning, and Salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 cups water (add more water if you like a broth soup)  2 tablespoons chicken base or seasoning (I use Better Than Bouillon) 4 tablespoons butter 4½ tablespoons all-purpose flour 8 ounces spaghetti noodles ½ cup heavy cream Instructions 1. Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat. Add the carrots, celery, and onion and cook for 5–7 minutes, or until they begin to soften. 2. Sprinkle in the flour and stir until the vegetables are evenly coated. Cook for 1–2 minutes. 3. Slowly pour in the water, stirring as you pour. Add the chicken base, garlic powder, thyme, parsley, oregano, buttery garlic & herb seasoning, salt, and black pepper. Stir well to combine. 4. Add the diced chicken breasts. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 10–15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and the vegetables are tender. 5. Break the spaghetti noodles in half and add them to the soup. Cook according to the package directions, stirring occasionally. 6. Once the noodles are tender, reduce the heat to low and stir in the heavy cream. Cook for another 2–3 minutes, just until warmed through. 7. Taste and adjust the seasonings as needed. If you like your soup with more broth, add additional water or chicken broth until it reaches your desired consistency. Note: The noodles will continue to absorb the broth as the soup sits, so you may need to add additional water or broth when reheating. #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #soupseason #comfortfood #quickrecipes

Classic Patty Melt Recipe Ingredients 1 lb 450 g ground beef (80/20 for best flavor) 4 slices rye bread 4 slices Swiss cheese 1 medium onion thinly sliced 2 tablespoons butter plus more for bread ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon black pepper ½ teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon oil Instructions Caramelize the onions Heat oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add sliced onions and cook slowly, stirring often, until soft, golden, and sweet (about 8–10 minutes). Remove from pan and set aside. Form the patties Divide beef into 2 thin oval patties shaped to match bread size. Season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Worcestershire sauce. Cook the burgers In the same skillet, cook patties over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Assemble the melts Butter one side of each bread slice. On the unbuttered side, layer: Swiss cheese Beef patty Caramelized onions Another slice of Swiss cheese Top with another slice of bread (buttered side facing out). Grill to perfection Place sandwiches in the skillet over medium heat. Cook 3–4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until bread is golden and cheese is fully melted.
